intro.en: Custom spiral coiled and retractile cable assemblies turn a flexible cable into a controlled moving connection. Coil diameter, body length, straight tails, working extension, restoring force, conductor and jacket construction, shielding, connectors and cycle validation are defined around the installed motion.
intro.zh: 定制螺旋卷线与伸缩电缆组件把柔性线缆变成受控的运动连接。线圈直径、卷绕段长度、直线尾段、工作拉伸、回弹力、导体与护套、屏蔽、连接器和循环验证都要围绕装机动作定义。

knowledge.en: A coiled cord is not a straight cable wound into a convenient shape. Materials retain process history, conductors and shields experience repeated strain, and every extension ratio changes force, recovery, heat and fatigue. The released geometry belongs to the specified cable construction and conditioning process.
knowledge.zh: 卷线电缆不是把普通直线简单绕成方便的形状。材料会保留成型历史，导体与屏蔽要承受反复应变，每一个拉伸倍率都会改变作用力、回弹、温升与疲劳。放行几何属于指定线缆结构与定型工艺。

notes.en: Provide retracted and working lengths, maximum permitted extension, coil outside and inside diameter, tail lengths and directions, mounting points, movement rate and cycles, cable circuits and electrical limits, connectors, environment, restoring-force target and acceptance method.
notes.zh: 请提供收缩与工作长度、允许最大拉伸、线圈内外径、尾段长度和方向、安装点、动作速度与次数、回路与电气限值、连接器、环境、回弹力目标与验收方法。

delivery.en: Release records the base cable, conductor and shield construction, coil direction and dimensions, tail geometry, connectors and overmolds, forming and conditioning controls, dimensional recovery method, electrical tests and agreed extension-cycle sampling.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录基础线缆、导体与屏蔽结构、卷绕方向与尺寸、尾段几何、连接器与包胶、成型和调理控制、尺寸恢复测量、电气测试及约定的拉伸循环抽样。

subtitle.en: Reach when the equipment moves. Recover when it returns.
subtitle.zh: 设备移动时延伸，归位后有序回收

lead.en: A useful coil balances reach, restoring force, stored strain, cable diameter and the space available around the equipment. The most compact-looking coil is not automatically the longest-lived one.
lead.zh: 实用卷线需要平衡可达距离、回弹力、储存应变、线缆外径与设备周边空间。看起来最紧凑的线圈，不一定拥有最长寿命。

title.en: Define the Coil as a Set of Working Dimensions
title.zh: 把线圈定义成一组工作尺寸

copy.en: The drawing distinguishes retracted coil-body length, maximum working length, coil outside and inside diameter, pitch, coil direction and the straight tail at each end. Tail direction may be axial, tangential or project-specific, and it determines how the cable exits the coil without rubbing the first turn. End-to-end length alone is insufficient because two cords with the same reach can store very different strain. Installation space, nearby edges and the usable motion envelope should be reviewed in both retracted and extended states.
copy.zh: 图纸要区分收缩卷绕段长度、最大工作长度、线圈内外径、节距、卷绕方向与两端直线尾段。尾段可轴向、切向或按项目定向，它决定线缆如何离开首圈而不摩擦。仅给端到端长度并不足够，因为相同可达距离的两条卷线可能储存完全不同的应变。安装空间、附近边缘与可用运动包络应在收缩和拉伸状态下同时审核。

title.en: Extension Ratio and Restoring Force Are a Trade-Off
title.zh: 拉伸倍率与回弹力是一项取舍

copy.en: A higher extension ratio can increase reach from a short package, but it also raises conductor and jacket strain, pull force and recovery demand. The operating point should stay below a mechanically damaging hard stretch, and the user should not rely on the cable as a load-bearing tether. Restoring force must be high enough to recover neatly but low enough not to pull a handheld device, connector or moving carriage off position. We define working, occasional maximum and prohibited extension zones rather than advertising one universal ratio.
copy.zh: 更高拉伸倍率能在短包络内获得更长行程，却也会增加导体与护套应变、拉力和回弹要求。工作点应远离会造成机械损伤的硬拉伸区，线缆也不应被当成承重牵引件。回弹力要足以整齐回收，又不能把手持设备、连接器或移动滑台拉离位置。因此应区分日常工作、偶发最大与禁止拉伸区域，而不是宣传一个通用倍率。

title.en: Fine Stranding, Lay and Fillers Support Repeated Motion
title.zh: 细绞、成缆与填充共同支持反复运动

copy.en: Conductor size still follows current, voltage drop and terminal range, but strand diameter, conductor class and cable lay influence bending fatigue. Cores need controlled movement inside the jacket without being crushed or migrating into an uneven coil. Fillers, separator tapes and core sequence can maintain roundness and reduce local stress. A cable qualified for occasional flexing is not automatically a high-cycle retractile cable; the final coiled construction and duty cycle need their own evidence.
copy.zh: 导体规格仍依据电流、压降与端子范围选择，但单丝直径、导体类别与成缆方式会影响弯曲疲劳。芯线需要在护套内受控运动，同时避免挤压或迁移造成线圈不均。填充、隔离带与芯线顺序可帮助保持圆整并降低局部应力。适合偶尔弯曲的线缆不等于高循环伸缩线，最终卷绕结构与工况需要自己的证据。

title.en: Jacket Memory, Temperature and Fluids Shape Recovery
title.zh: 护套记忆、温度与介质决定回弹表现

copy.en: PUR, TPE, PVC and other compounds differ in elasticity, abrasion, oil and chemical resistance, low-temperature flexibility, heat aging and processability. Material family names do not guarantee identical behavior; hardness, wall thickness and compound formulation matter. A cord that recovers quickly at room temperature may relax, stiffen or become tacky at another temperature or after fluid exposure. Color, flame performance and regulatory requirements are specified separately from the mechanical memory needed for the coil.
copy.zh: PUR、TPE、PVC 与其他材料在弹性、耐磨、耐油与化学品、低温柔性、热老化和加工性上不同。材料家族名称不能保证相同行为，硬度、壁厚和配方同样重要。室温下快速回弹的卷线，在另一温度或接触介质后可能松弛、变硬或发黏。颜色、阻燃与法规要求应与线圈所需机械记忆分别定义。

title.en: Shielding Must Survive Extension Without Restricting the Coil
title.zh: 屏蔽既要承受拉伸，也不能锁死线圈

copy.en: Sensor, encoder, audio, communication and data coils may need twisted pairs, pair shields or an overall shield. Braid, spiral serve, foil and composite shields trade electrical coverage against flex and torsional freedom. A stiff shield can increase restoring force and concentrate strain, while a poorly controlled shield can open, bunch or break near the tails. Shield-to-shell termination, drain path, impedance and high-speed signal requirements are reviewed together with the coil—not copied from a straight-cable drawing.
copy.zh: 传感器、编码器、音频、通信与数据卷线可能需要双绞、分对屏蔽或总屏蔽。编织、螺旋缠绕、铝箔与复合屏蔽在电气覆盖、弯曲与扭转自由度之间各有取舍。过硬屏蔽会提高回弹力并集中应变，控制不当的屏蔽则可能在尾段附近张开、堆积或断裂。屏蔽到外壳端接、排流路径、阻抗与高速信号要求要和卷线一起审核，不能直接复制直线电缆图纸。

title.en: Straight Tails, Connectors and Strain Relief Carry the Transition
title.zh: 直线尾段、连接器与应力释放承担过渡

copy.en: The first coil turn and the connector entry are common stress locations. Tail length must allow mounting and service without forcing the coil against an edge; connector orientation and keying should match the installed reach. USB, RJ45, M8/M12, circular, audio, trailer, medical and proprietary interfaces can be assembled when the exact mating part and pin map are defined. Overmold and boot geometry should create a progressive transition rather than a hard hinge beside the termination.
copy.zh: 首圈与连接器入口是常见应力位置。尾段长度要满足安装和维护，避免线圈压在边缘；连接器方向与防呆应匹配实际运动。只要准确对插件与针脚明确，可制作 USB、RJ45、M8/M12、圆形、音频、拖车、医疗或专用接口。包胶和尾套应形成渐进过渡，而不是在端接旁制造硬铰链。

title.en: Forming and Conditioning Belong to the Released Process
title.zh: 卷绕成型与调理属于放行工艺

copy.en: A straight cable is wound on controlled tooling and conditioned according to the material and geometry. Mandrel size, pitch, direction, temperature, dwell, cooling and post-form relaxation influence final diameter, length and memory. Excessive heat can age insulation, change electrical dimensions or deform connectors; insufficient conditioning can leave unstable geometry. Dimensional inspection should state the recovery time and temperature after extension because a coil measured immediately and one measured after rest can differ.
copy.zh: 直线电缆在受控工装上卷绕，并按材料与几何进行调理。芯轴尺寸、节距、方向、温度、保温、冷却与成型后松弛都会影响最终直径、长度和记忆。过热会老化绝缘、改变电气尺寸或使连接器变形，调理不足则留下不稳定几何。尺寸检验应规定拉伸后的恢复时间与温度，因为立即测量和静置后测量可能不同。

title.en: Validate Recovery, Electrical Function and the Installed Cycle
title.zh: 验证回弹、电气功能与真实装机循环

copy.en: Production inspection covers wiring, shorts, conductor resistance, shield and shell paths, dimensions, connector retention and molding condition. Coil-specific checks measure retracted length, working extension, restoring force and recovery after a defined rest. Cycle tests should reproduce extension distance, rate, dwell, mounting, temperature and electrical load; periodic resistance or signal monitoring can reveal intermittent damage. A cycle count has meaning only when the motion profile and acceptance criteria are stated.
copy.zh: 生产检验包括接线、短路、导体电阻、屏蔽与外壳路径、尺寸、连接器保持和包胶状态。卷线专项检查测量收缩长度、工作拉伸、回弹力与规定静置后的恢复。循环试验应复现拉伸距离、速度、停留、安装、温度与电气负载，并可周期监控电阻或信号以发现间歇损伤。只有动作谱与验收标准明确时，循环次数才有意义。

inputs.en: Retracted body length, working reach, occasional maximum and prohibited extension
inputs.zh: 收缩卷绕段、工作行程、偶发最大与禁止拉伸长度

inputs.en: Coil inside/outside diameter, pitch, direction, tail lengths and exit orientation
inputs.zh: 线圈内外径、节距、方向、尾段长度与出线方向

inputs.en: Circuits, current, voltage drop, signal protocol, shielding and grounding
inputs.zh: 回路、电流、压降、信号协议、屏蔽与接地

inputs.en: Both connectors, mating parts, pin map, retention, overmold and mounting points
inputs.zh: 两端连接器、对插件、针脚、锁止、包胶与安装点

inputs.en: Motion rate, cycles, restoring-force range, abrasion, oils, temperature and cleaning
inputs.zh: 动作速度、次数、回弹力范围、磨损、油污、温度与清洁

inputs.en: Sample quantity, dimensional recovery method, electrical and cycle acceptance limits
inputs.zh: 样品数量、尺寸恢复测量、电气与循环验收限值

q.en: What extension ratio should a coiled cable use?
q.zh: 卷线电缆应该选择多大拉伸倍率？

a.en: There is no universal value. Reach, cable construction, coil diameter, force, environment and required life determine the working and maximum extension zones.
a.zh: 没有通用值。可达距离、线缆结构、线圈直径、作用力、环境与寿命共同决定工作和最大拉伸区域。

q.zh: 卷线必须使用 PUR 吗？

a.en: No. PUR is often useful for abrasion, fluids and recovery, but the exact compound, temperature, electrical, flame and regulatory needs determine the material.
a.zh: 不一定。PUR 常用于耐磨、介质与回弹需求，但最终材料由具体配方、温度、电气、阻燃与法规要求决定。

q.en: Can a shielded data cable be made into a coil?
q.zh: 屏蔽数据线可以做成卷线吗？

a.en: Yes when pair geometry, impedance, shield flexibility, endpoint transition and the extension cycle are engineered together and validated at the target rate and length.
a.zh: 可以，但要协同设计线对几何、阻抗、屏蔽柔性、端点过渡与拉伸循环，并按目标速率和长度验证。

q.en: Can the ends use different connectors?
q.zh: 两端可以使用不同连接器吗？

a.en: Yes. Straight tails can terminate in different standard or proprietary connectors when the exact mating references, pin map, orientation and strain relief are supplied.
a.zh: 可以。只要准确对插件、针脚、方向与应力释放明确，两端直线尾段可连接不同标准或专用接口。

q.en: Why does a coil stop returning to its original length?
q.zh: 卷线为什么会逐渐无法恢复原长度？

a.en: Possible causes include material relaxation, excessive extension, heat, chemical exposure, internal conductor or shield damage, and an unsuitable forming process. The actual duty cycle must be reviewed.
a.zh: 可能原因包括材料松弛、过度拉伸、热、化学介质、内部导体或屏蔽损伤以及不合适的成型工艺，需要结合真实工况判断。

a.en: Send retracted and working dimensions, force expectations, cable circuits, endpoints, motion profile, environment, quantity and the required dimensional, electrical and cycle validation.
a.zh: 请提供收缩与工作尺寸、回弹力预期、回路、端点、动作谱、环境、数量以及所需尺寸、电气与循环验证。
